title: Badi local adapter protocol v2
description: Normative framed-JSON protocol. A frame is a 4-byte little-endian length followed by one UTF-8 instance of this schema and is limited to 65536 bytes.

mono_ms.description: Sender-local monotonic timestamp for ordering and latency only; never compare epochs across processes.

fingerprint.description: Ephemeral opaque race token computed from a fresh session salt, stable target identity, bounded before/after context, and full-target Unicode scalar start/end offsets. Focus epoch and revision are independent address fields that must also match. It is equality data, not adapter authentication, and must not be logged or persisted.

app_id.description: Exact canonical Fcitx program identity; never a title or display label.
The LibreOffice Writer extension's only identity; its settings subject is linux_app/libreoffice.

selection.description: Full-target selection offsets in Unicode scalar values as reported by the cooperative Fcitx surrounding-text adapter. The broker treats these as opaque state/equality data and performs no text indexing with them.

policyResolutionReason.description: snoozed: the user snoozed this target's app or site for a few minutes (control action snooze); every grant there is withheld until it runs out or snooze_end.

context_words.description: Context is on for this target (ADR 0010): an observed field may send the text near it as window_text. It grants nothing else. Producers omit it when false.

contextText.description: Bounded editor context. Controls and line breaks are permitted; lone UTF-16 surrogate code units U+D800-U+DFFF are rejected while valid astral scalar pairs remain allowed.

before.description: UTF-8 wire text capped at 512 Unicode scalar values immediately before the selection.

after.description: UTF-8 wire text capped at 128 Unicode scalar values immediately after the selection.

window_text.description: Text near an observed field in the same window, capped at 2,048 Unicode scalar values, sent only while the policy reply says context_words. The broker uses its words to finish the word being typed and keeps them only for this request (ADR 0010). Absent for denied, sensitive and unobserved fields.

safeSuggestionText.description: V2 safe output text. Permits only isolated U+0020 spaces (at most one leading and one trailing), rejects a repeated space and every other Unicode whitespace, C0/C1 controls, U+2028/U+2029, UTF-16 surrogate code units U+D800-U+DFFF, and the exact Unicode 16/17 Cf set: U+00AD, U+0600-U+0605, U+061C, U+06DD, U+070F, U+0890-U+0891, U+08E2, U+180E, U+200B, U+200D-U+200F, U+202A-U+202E, U+2060-U+2064, U+2066-U+206F, U+FEFF, U+FFF9-U+FFFB, U+110BD, U+110CD, U+13430-U+1343F, U+1BCA0-U+1BCA3, U+1D173-U+1D17A, U+E0001, and U+E0020-U+E007F. The broker shows a trailing space only when the caret already follows whitespace and a letter or digit follows the caret. A single U+200C (Persian ZWNJ) is permitted only immediately between Arabic-block letters U+0620-U+063F, U+0641-U+064A, U+066E-U+066F, U+0671-U+06D3, U+06D5, U+06E5-U+06E6, U+06EE-U+06EF, U+06FA-U+06FC or U+06FF; leading, trailing, repeated and cross-script joiners remain forbidden.

spellingSuffixPair.description: A negotiated spelling edit replaces one word of 2-32 characters with case (Unicode Lowercase or Uppercase; protocol/spelling-replacement-fixtures.json) and optionally preserves its one trailing ASCII space. Producers and consumers additionally require different words and, for suggestions, accept_word equal to text.

replace_before.description: Exact suffix replaced only by adapters negotiating text_replacement; bound to the original context and commit grant.

ttl_ms.description: Relative receiver-local lifetime starting when this frame is received. Native and editor clients negotiating long_reading_window receive up to 15 seconds; other native and editor clients retain five seconds, and browser leases remain 600 ms. Extensions and type-through never renew the original expiry.

minutes.description: How long a snooze withholds the focused field's app or site. Present exactly for snooze.

snoozeSubject.description: The exact settings identity a snooze withholds: a site origin or an app id, never a window title.

commitPreparePayload.description: Single-use commit authorization. The broker's receiver-local result lease defaults to 1500 ms and is hard-clamped to 5000 ms; adapters must apply and report immediately, and a matching suggestion.clear revokes an authorization not yet applied.

replace_before.description: Exact suffix replaced only by adapters negotiating text_replacement; bound to the original context and commit grant.

typeThroughMetrics.description: Content-free type-through outcomes (ADR 0004): requests answered from the carry, and admitted requests that reached the provider although a carry existed, by the gate that declined it. Optional for brokers that predate the breakdown.

noSuggestionMetrics.description: Content-free classes of provider calls that ended without a displayed suggestion; each call counts once. Optional for brokers that predate the breakdown.

low_confidence.description: Suggestions withheld because a token was less likely than the confidence floor. Optional for brokers that predate the confidence gate.

probeRequestPayload.description: Private same-UID CLI diagnostic. It opens no session, grants no commit authority, and its text is neither logged nor retained.

explicit.description: Use the explicit-request writing budget (1200 ms) instead of the automatic one (550 ms).

snoozes.description: Every app or site snoozed now, in identity order; omitted when none is.

desktopSession.description: The login session as logind reports it. Inactive (another session or VT in the foreground) and sleeping hold every grant until the helper reports active again or disconnects.

desktopStatePayload.description: Content-free report from the desktop session helper (capability desktop_signals). It never grants authority. Unknown power state is reported as false.

desktopStatusPayload.description: The broker's combined view of every connected helper's report. automatic is normal unless low_power is true and settings choose a battery mode.

editorFocusPayload.description: An editor running in a terminal (capability editor_focus, Neovim only) reports whether it holds that terminal's focus. Content-free and bound to the reporting connection; it never grants authority.

editorStatusPayload.description: Whether any connected editor holds its terminal's focus. While one does, desktop_application targets resolve to policy reason editor_focused and every grant there is withheld.

styleKeyPayload.description: The keyring's style-learning key (capability style_key). Never logged or stored by the broker.

contextStatusPayload.description: Content-free state of opt-in context (ADR 0010): whether it is on, whether the user has chosen, and learned-word counts. Never a word.

styleSamplesPayload.description: An explicit export of decrypted style samples (settings capability, CLI only).
